hymns.text: Τὴν ἀκαθαίρετον, Τριάδος δύναμιν, ἀνθηφορήσαντες, Μάρτυρες ἔνδοξοι, ἐναπετέματε στερρῶς, τὴν ἄκανθαν τῆς ἀπάτης, Τρόφιμε μακάριε, Ἐκκλησίας ἐντρύφημα, Σαββάτιε πάνσοφε, Ἀθλητῶν ἐγκαλλώπισμα, καὶ δόξα εὐσεβῶν Δορυμέδων ὅθεν ὑμᾶς ἀνευφημοῦμεν.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr) — Άγιοι Τρόφιμος, Σαββάτιος και Δορυμέδων, Λειτουργικά κείμενα: Ἀπολυτίκιον

english.text: Bearing as a flower the indestructible power of the Trinity, O glorious martyrs, ye did steadfastly cut down the thorn of deceit: O blessed Trophimus, delight of the Church; O all-wise Sabbatius, adornment of the contestants; and O Dorymedon, glory of the pious. Wherefore we sing your praises.

hymns.text: Ὡς ἀθλητῶν ἑδραίωμα, καὶ εὐσεβείας ἔρεισμα, ἡ Ἐκκλησία τιμᾷ καὶ γεραίρει σου, τὴν φωτοφόρον ἄθλησιν· παναοίδιμε μάκαρ, ἀθλητὰ γενναιόφρον, ἔνδοξε Τρόφιμε, σὺν τοῖς συνάθλοις σου, ἱλασμὸν τοῖς ὑμνοῦσί σε αἴτησαι, ὡς ἀήττητος.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr) — Άγιοι Τρόφιμος, Σαββάτιος και Δορυμέδων, Λειτουργικά κείμενα: Κοντάκιον

english.text: As a firm foundation of contestants and a support of piety, the Church honoureth and magnifieth thy light-bearing contest, O all-renowned and blessed one, valiant-minded contestant, glorious Trophimus. Together with them that contended with thee, ask remission for those who hymn thee, as one unconquered.

hymns.text: Ca unul ce eşti întărire nevoitorilor şi reazem al dreptei credinţe, Biserica cinsteşte şi laudă nevoinţa ta cea luminată, pururea pomenite, pătimitorule, viteazule Mărite Mucenice Trofim. Împreună cu cei ce s-au nevoit cu tine, fericite, cere milostivire pentru cei ce te laudă pe tine, ca unul ce eşti nebiruit.

source.text: Doxologia — Condacul Sfinţilor Mucenici Trofim, Savatie şi Dorimedont

english.text: As one who art the strengthening of them that struggle and the support of the right faith, the Church honoureth and praiseth thy radiant struggle, O ever-remembered sufferer, valiant and glorious martyr Trophimus. Together with those who struggled with thee, O blessed one, ask mercy for those who praise thee, as one unconquered.

hymns.text: Dumnezeu Cel Lăudat în Treime a preamărit treimea mucenicilor; pe Sfântul Trofim, pe Sfântul Savatie şi pe Sfântul Dorimedont; căci, întru Dânsul crezând, au surpat pe vrăjmaşul. Prin rugăciunile lor, Hristoase Dumnezeule, miluieşte-ne pe noi.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfinţilor Mucenici Trofim, Savatie şi Dorimedont

english.text: God, who is praised in Trinity, hath greatly glorified the trinity of martyrs: Saint Trophimus, Saint Sabbatius and Saint Dorymedon; for believing in him they cast down the enemy. Through their prayers, O Christ God, have mercy on us.
